title: Suspicious Activity Detected: Artificially Inflated GitHub Stars
body:
Dear Maintainers,

I have noticed some irregularities in the star count of this repository, which strongly suggest the use of artificial methods to inflate its popularity (commonly referred to as "star farming" or "star boosting"). Upon closer inspection, it appears that a significant portion of the stars come from accounts that exhibit suspicious activity, such as minimal or no genuine contributions to other repositories, creation dates clustered within a short timeframe, and/or generic usernames.

Engaging in such practices not only undermines the spirit of open source but also violates GitHub's Terms of Service. Open source thrives on transparency, collaboration, and a genuine appreciation of contributions. Artificially boosting metrics misleads the community and erodes trust, which is detrimental to the ecosystem as a whole.

I want to emphasize the importance of earning recognition through meaningful contributions and community engagement rather than resorting to manipulative tactics. A project's value lies not in the numbers but in the real-world impact it creates and the trust it fosters among developers.

To uphold the integrity of the platform, I have reported this activity to GitHub’s support team for further investigation. I kindly urge you to address this situation openly by acknowledging any mistakes (if applicable) and taking corrective measures. A public apology and commitment to ethical practices moving forward would go a long way in restoring community faith.

Let us work together to build an open-source community that values honesty, quality, and collaboration above all else.

Thank you for your understanding.

title: 疑似刷星行为及社区价值观讨论

近期，我注意到您的项目在短时间内获得了大量的 GitHub Star。然而，通过分析这些 Star 的来源和行为模式，我发现很多账号的活动轨迹与真实用户的使用习惯并不符合，疑似存在通过购买或其他方式刷星的行为。这种行为不仅有违开源社区的公平原则，也可能影响其他开发者对项目的信任和评价。  

刷星行为虽然可能短期内提升项目的表面人气，但对于真正热爱技术和开源事业的人来说，项目的质量、社区的氛围以及实际解决问题的能力才是最重要的评判标准。开源社区的核心价值在于真实、透明和开放，任何试图以非正当手段提升人气的行为都会破坏这一生态。  

我已将相关情况反馈至 GitHub 官方，期待他们能够进行进一步的调查。如果您确实知晓或参与了这一行为，建议您尽快承认并公开道歉，同时采取措施纠正问题。坦诚面对错误不仅能够挽回社区对您的信任，也有助于您的项目在长期发展中获得真正的支持者。  

希望您能够认真审视此问题，并以维护开源社区健康发展的态度作出积极回应。  

期待您的回音。

title: Unusual Spike in Repository Stars – Concerns About Authenticity
body:
Hello,

I recently observed an unusual and rather concerning spike in the number of stars for this repository. Upon closer inspection, it appears that many of these stars may be from fake or inactive accounts, which raises suspicions about the authenticity of these engagements. While I cannot definitively confirm the use of paid services or automated methods to inflate these numbers, the evidence strongly suggests the possibility of star manipulation.

As an open-source advocate, I deeply value the principles of transparency, authenticity, and meritocracy in our community. Artificially inflating star counts distorts these values and misleads users who rely on metrics like stars to gauge the quality and impact of a project. It also undermines the trust and integrity of the GitHub ecosystem as a whole.

I believe it is important for everyone in this community to embrace true merit: the growth of a project should reflect the genuine support and engagement of the community. Gaining recognition through non-authentic means distracts from the hard work and passion that go into creating valuable open-source contributions.

To maintain the integrity of this platform, I have reported this activity to GitHub's support team for further investigation. I encourage the project owner to address this issue openly — if any misconduct has occurred, acknowledging it and taking corrective action, such as discontinuing these practices and issuing an apology, would be a step in the right direction. Transparency and accountability could help restore trust and respect within the community.

I hope this issue acts as a constructive nudge to reflect on the values we want to foster in the open-source ecosystem. Let’s collectively strive to build an environment where projects are celebrated for their genuine impact and contributions.

Looking forward to the project owner’s response.

Kind regards.

title: 大量虚假 Star？开源精神不该这样！
body:
你好~  
最近几天我注意到这个项目的 star 数量像坐了火箭一样飙升，但实际上 repo 内部内容更新不多，issue 和 pr 的活跃度也不够匹配，这看起来非常反常。我还通过几个第三方工具查询了一下，star 的来源也相当可疑，不乏大量空账户和短时间内集中漂进来的动作……  

诚实和透明才是开源社区最基本的精神。如果这些 star 真的不是自然获得的，而是购买或者其他方式刷出来的，那真的很对不起支持真实开源的开发者们。炸 star 的行为或许可以临时骗到一部分眼球，但长期来看其实损害了一整个项目的可信度啊。  

希望项目的维护者们可以诚实地面对这个情况。如果真是你们购买的，希望主动承认并且对社区表达个认识错误的态度。这不仅是对项目，更是对所有信任你们的人的负责！锤人或者爆锅都不是目的，初心是希望大家都更好～  

Give open source a brighter future! :]
